_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:
Simulator settings and results now have separate scrollable views, a collapsible USB/cuff setup guide and persistent progress, Start/STOP, recordings folder and MAP scatter controls. Keep the existing bench tools, paired BP lists, green/red outcomes, one-cycle recordings and 30-second breaks.

The settings/queue height adapts to short windows, keeping trial actions visible above the legacy tools.

The read-only MAP scatter can load completed Smart Const measurements recorded on Default and excludes fallback holds. It labels reference MAP as calculated from simulator settings.

Valinor retains its Max80 through Max220 menu, standalone/GUI parity and unchanged rev27v-gauge-38 firmware and control profile. Focused Simulator/BPF/calibration-isolation tests, legacy checks, layout and mock GUI smoke passed. Calibration profiles and prior records are preserved.
